title: Integrated control of MRSA biological contamination via SarA-targeting gamma-mangostin: A green natural antimicrobial strategy.
authors: Ma, Qiang; Chen, Meinuo; Zhuo, Nachuan; Sun, Boyan; Liu, Zimo; Julaiti, Ayinigaer; Wang, Xiaomei; Wang, Sihan; Jiang, Haiyang
one_liner_zh: 该文以SarA蛋白为靶点筛选天然抗菌剂，虽涉及SarA-DNA结合域MD模拟，但核心是抗菌策略而非TF-DNA互作机制建模，方法可迁移但深度有限。
abstract: Methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) remains a major public health threat owing to its pronounced antibiotic resistance, multiple virulence factors, and robust biofilm-forming capacity, yet effective integrated antimicrobial strategies are still lacking. The global regulator SarA serves as a regulatory hub that simultaneously governs these key MRSA hazard determinants. Here, we report a comprehensive platform for the all-round control of MRSA biological contamination, centered on a label-free electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS)-based biosensing system designed to screen inhibitors targeting SarA. Using this platform, the fruit-derived flavonoid gamma-mangostin (gamma-MG) was identified as a potent SarA inhibitor. Further MD simulations revealed that gamma-MG spontaneously and stably engaged residues within the DNA-binding domain, particularly VAL68 and VAL92, thereby attenuating structural fluctuations. gamma-MG markedly reduced MRSA viability (MIC=8 mug/mL) inhibited biofilm formation, and effectively eliminated MRSA in milk. gamma-MG quenched the intrinsic fluorescence of SarA and elicited a substantially greater impedance response at the SarA-modified gold electrode (DeltaZ'=6.442 kOmega) relative to the positive control Morin (DeltaZ'=1.614 kOmega). Transcriptomic and bioinformatic analyses revealed broad perturbation of SarA-regulated pathways, encompassing transcriptional activity, cell adhesion, stress response, and cell wall homeostasis, a profile closely resembling that of the DeltasarA mutant. Animal infection models confirmed the therapeutic efficacy and decontamination capacity of gamma-MG against MRSA. Collectively, this study provides an effective strategy and a sensitive analytical tool for the integrated prevention and control of MRSA contamination.
abstract_zh: 耐甲氧西林金黄色葡萄球菌（MRSA）因其显著的抗生素耐药性、多种毒力因子和强大的生物膜形成能力，仍然是主要的公共卫生威胁，然而有效的综合抗菌策略仍缺乏。全局调控因子SarA作为一个调控枢纽，同时控制着这些关键的MRSA危害决定因素。在此，我们报告了一个全面控制MRSA生物污染的综合平台，该平台以基于无标记电化学阻抗谱（EIS）的生物传感系统为核心，旨在筛选靶向SarA的抑制剂。利用该平台，水果来源的黄酮类化合物γ-倒捻子素（gamma-MG）被鉴定为一种强效的SarA抑制剂。进一步的分子动力学（MD）模拟揭示，gamma-MG自发且稳定地结合DNA结合域内的残基，特别是VAL68和VAL92，从而减弱结构波动。gamma-MG显著降低MRSA的存活率（MIC=8 μg/mL），抑制生物膜形成，并有效清除牛奶中的MRSA。gamma-MG猝灭了SarA的内源荧光，并在SarA修饰的金电极上引发了显著更大的阻抗响应（ΔZ'=6.442 kΩ），相对于阳性对照桑色素（ΔZ'=1.614 kΩ）。转录组学和生物信息学分析揭示了SarA调控通路的广泛扰动，涵盖转录活性、细胞粘附、应激反应和细胞壁稳态，这一特征与ΔsarA突变体高度相似。动物感染模型证实了gamma-MG对MRSA的治疗效果和去污能力。总体而言，本研究为MRSA污染的综合防控提供了一种有效策略和灵敏的分析工具。
